settingsEmailMarketing.title: Email Infrastructure
settingsEmailMarketing.description: Sending domains, providers, pools and subscription categories for outbound email.
settingsEmailMarketing.noWorkspaceDetail: Pick a workspace to manage its email infrastructure.

domains.description: Domains you send from, their DNS verification, and warming schedules.
domains.emptyDetail: Add a domain and verify its DNS records before your first campaign goes out.

providers.description: The services that actually deliver your mail — SES, SendGrid, SMTP.
providers.emptyDetail: A provider is what actually delivers the mail. Without one, campaigns cannot send.

pools.description: Pools spread a campaign across several domains, so one domain's reputation can't sink the whole send.
pools.name: Name
pools.memberCount: {count, plural, =0 {no domains} one {# domain} other {# domains}}
pools.emptyDetail: Without a pool a campaign sends from the single domain its From address belongs to. A pool lets it use several, chosen per recipient.
pools.noVerifiedYet: You have no verified domains yet, so this pool will start empty and route nothing.
pools.noMembers: No domains in this pool — it can't route anything yet.
pools.allAdded: Every verified domain is already in this pool.
pools.needVerifiedDomain: Verify a domain before adding it to a pool.

health_based.label: Healthiest first
health_based.detail: Picks the domain with the best reputation and most headroom, favouring one the recipient's provider already trusts.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.detail: Spreads volume evenly by sending from whichever domain has sent least today.

weighted.label: Weighted
weighted.detail: Splits traffic by each member's weight — useful while warming a new domain alongside an established one.

failover.label: Failover
failover.detail: Always uses the highest-priority domain, dropping to the next only when it can't send.

categories.description: Subscription categories let recipients choose which kinds of email they want.
categories.emptyDetail: Categories let recipients unsubscribe from one kind of email without leaving the rest.
